name: CIRCA demo content
notes: Demo identities (names, bios and captions are invented) on licensed stock footage of real performers from Mixkit, with licensed music from Mixkit's composers. The performers are not the people named. Real NASA shows and episodes, excerpted (five minutes each). NASA media is public domain; NASA does not endorse CIRCA. Sample listeners and every listening figure are simulated.

creators.name: Ellis Rae
creators.bio: Writes in a brick-walled room in Bushwick with one good microphone and the lights low. Low Light is the first thing he's let leave the room.

creators.name: Marisol Vega
creators.bio: Grew up on her grandmother's bolero records and plays them back through a soul band. Candela was recorded live in one afternoon.

creators.name: Juniper & Lowe
creators.bio: A guitar and a banjo that met busking outside the same coffee shop. They still play the street on Sundays.

creators.name: Kairo Banks
creators.bio: Records at night after shifts at his uncle's shop. Night Shift is the sound of that commute.

creators.name: Nova Lin
creators.bio: Plays every small club that will have her and treats each like an arena. Afterglow is written for the walk home after.

creators.name: The Halyards
creators.bio: Four friends from a sailing town who got loud. Undertow is their first single on a real label.

creators.name: Houston We Have a Podcast
creators.bio: NASA Johnson Space Center's official podcast: long-form conversations with the people who fly, train and plan human spaceflight.

creators.name: Rocket Ranch
creators.bio: NASA Kennedy Space Center's podcast about the people and work behind getting to space.

creators.name: Down to Earth: Conversations
creators.bio: A NASA series pairing astronauts with students to talk about what living and working in space is really like.

creators.name: NASA Science Live
creators.bio: A live show where NASA scientists answer questions about the universe, from black holes to rising seas.

songs.title: Low Light
songs.blurb: Unhurried alt-soul for the last hour before sleep.

songs.title: Candela
songs.blurb: Piano, double bass and a bolero heart, played slow.

songs.title: Paper Lanterns
songs.blurb: Front-porch folk with nowhere to be.

songs.title: Night Shift
songs.blurb: Late-night bars over a slow, heavy beat.

songs.title: Afterglow
songs.blurb: Future-bass pop built for the last song of the night.

songs.title: Undertow
songs.blurb: Big guitars and a chorus for a room full of hands.

episodes.title: Mental Health with Shinedown
episodes.topic: In honour of Mental Health Awareness Month, the rock band Shinedown talks with an astronaut and NASA researchers about mental health for touring band members, orbiting astronauts and everyone.

episodes.title: Artemis Flight Directors
episodes.topic: Gary Jordan walks through Artemis I, the uncrewed test flight around the Moon, with lead flight director Rick LaBrode and ascent and entry flight director Judd Frieling.

episodes.title: Landing on Mars, Protecting Mars
episodes.topic: Dr. Moogega Cooper, planetary protection lead for the Perseverance rover at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, on the manoeuvres needed to land on Mars and how her team protects it.

episodes.title: Sensory Overload
episodes.topic: Astronaut Sunita Williams and environmental studies student Adrien Prouty explore what it's like to do a spacewalk on the International Space Station.

episodes.title: Black Hole 101
episodes.topic: NASA scientists on what black holes are, and how we know they exist even though we can't see them.

ic-ellis-session.text: Leaving the crack in is the whole point. Please never fix it.
Already know this one is going to wreck me.
That breath before the chorus. Twice.

ic-ellis-rehearsal.text: Danny on guitar is the secret weapon.
The chord change at 0:07 is a whole other song.

ic-halyards-soundcheck.text: That window light should get a writing credit.
Would happily listen to forty minutes of this soundcheck.
Mira says thank you. The light says nothing.

ic-halyards-crowd.text: I was in that crowd. Still can’t hear properly.
Undertow live is a different animal.

ic-nova-dance.text: See you in that room tonight, front left.
The choreo is going to be everywhere by summer.
front left gets the encore wave.

ic-juniper-lowe-street.text: The kid dancing deserves a writing credit.
splitting it 50/50 with the kid, yes.

ic-kairo-booth.text: Verse two. Put it out exactly like this.
Played this on my commute three times today.

ic-marisol-warmup.text: the room does half the work, honestly.

ic-nova-stage.text: I could hear it from the bar. Loudest crowd of the year.
